queries.name: bom-plan
queries.description: Returns the legacy PYMAC production-plan bill of materials hierarchy.
queries.sql: SELECT vibb.plan_assyline AS assyLine, vibb.assyplan_date AS forecastDate, vibb.assyplan_seq AS forecastSeq, vibb.model_code AS model_code, vibb.spec_code AS model_specCode, vibb.model_name AS model_description, SUM(vibb.assyplan_qty) AS forecast_plannedQuantity, dii.itemno AS partcode, dii.item_name AS partdescription, dii.item_type AS parttype, ext.qty_per AS quantityperunit, dii.itemno AS pymac_itemno, dii.supplier AS pymac_supplier, dii.usercd AS pymac_user, dii.item_name AS pymac_itemname, ext.comp_sign, SUM(vibb.assyplan_qty) AS pymac_sumqty, ext.in_eff_ymd AS in_date, ext.in_rev_no AS in_revision, ext.out_eff_ymd AS out_date, ext.out_rev_no AS out_revision, ext.structure_num AS structure_no, ext.supply_station, ext.split_sign, ext.structure_seq, dii.item_type AS pymac_itemtype, dii.item_class, dii.item_status, dii.process_no, dii.low_level_cd AS low_level, vibb.color_code AS color_info, diic.measure_unit, diic.weight_unit, dim.weight, dii.mrp_demand_pol_cd AS mrp_demand_policy, dii.deliv_pf_no AS delivery_pf_no, dii.stock_location AS stock_loc, dii.order_policy_cd AS order_policy, dii.airs_sign AS airs, ext.p_itemno AS parent_child_item, ext.p_supplier AS parent_child_supplier, ext.p_usercd AS parent_child_user FROM (SELECT DISTINCT p_itemno, p_supplier, p_usercd, 0 AS level, c_itemno, c_supplier, c_usercd, qty_per, structure_seq, comp_sign, in_eff_ymd, in_rev_no, out_eff_ymd, out_rev_no, structure_num, supply_station, split_sign FROM de_int_ps WHERE TRIM(c_itemno) = TRIM(:p_item) AND c_supplier = CASE WHEN :p_area_provider IS NULL THEN p_supplier ELSE :p_area_provider END AND c_usercd = CASE WHEN :p_area_user IS NULL THEN p_usercd ELSE :p_area_user END UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT p_itemno, p_supplier, p_usercd, LEVEL, c_itemno, c_supplier, c_usercd, qty_per, structure_seq, comp_sign, in_eff_ymd, in_rev_no, out_eff_ymd, out_rev_no, structure_num, supply_station, split_sign FROM de_int_ps START WITH TRIM(p_itemno) = TRIM(:p_item) AND p_supplier = CASE WHEN :p_area_provider IS NULL THEN p_supplier ELSE :p_area_provider END AND p_usercd = CASE WHEN :p_area_user IS NULL THEN p_usercd ELSE :p_area_user END CONNECT BY NOCYCLE PRIOR c_itemno = p_itemno AND PRIOR c_supplier = p_supplier AND PRIOR c_usercd = p_usercd) ext INNER JOIN vic_int_bdeg_bsasypl vibb ON vibb.part_no = DECODE(ext.level, 0, ext.c_itemno, ext.p_itemno) AND vibb.supplier_user_cd = DECODE(ext.level, 0, ext.c_supplier, ext.p_supplier) AND TO_DATE(vibb.assyplan_date, '%Y%m%d') >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) INNER JOIN vic_int_bodyprd vib ON vibb.assyplan_key = vib.assyplan_key AND (vib.assy_date IS NULL OR TRIM(vib.assy_date) = '') INNER JOIN de_int_im dii ON ext.c_itemno = dii.itemno AND ext.c_supplier = dii.supplier AND ext.c_usercd = dii.usercd INNER JOIN de_int_itemcomn diic ON dii.itemno = diic.itemno INNER JOIN de_int_itemmast dim ON dii.itemno = dim.itemno AND dii.supplier = dim.supplier AND dii.usercd = dim.usercd GROUP BY vibb.plan_assyline, vibb.assyplan_date, vibb.assyplan_seq, vibb.model_code, vibb.spec_code, vibb.model_name, ext.qty_per, dii.itemno, dii.item_name, dii.item_type, dii.supplier, dii.usercd, ext.comp_sign, ext.in_eff_ymd, ext.in_rev_no, ext.out_eff_ymd, ext.out_rev_no, ext.structure_num, ext.supply_station, ext.split_sign, ext.structure_seq, dii.item_class, dii.item_status, dii.process_no, dii.low_level_cd, vibb.color_code, diic.measure_unit, diic.weight_unit, dim.weight, dii.mrp_demand_pol_cd, dii.deliv_pf_no, dii.stock_location, dii.order_policy_cd, dii.airs_sign, ext.p_itemno, ext.p_supplier, ext.p_usercd
